comments.content: The new browser context created in `withUser` is never closed, which leaks resources across tests. Since only `newN8n` (wrapping the page) is returned, the caller has no handle to `context` to close it. Consider tracking the created contexts for cleanup (e.g. via a fixture teardown) or returning the context/page so it can be closed.

The `secondBrowser` obtained from `n8n.start.withUser(newTestUser)` is never disposed, leaking a browser context. Since `withUser` doesn't expose the context, this test can't close it. Consider adding a way to clean up (see the `withUser` implementation comment).
